name: planet-express
title: Planet Express
author: CrazyFeSS
description:
Cross-planet delivery that just works.

Hauling goods between planets in Space Age means babysitting platform schedules and cargo requests by hand. Planet Express does it for you. Enrol a few cargo ships into a fleet, tell each planet what it needs on its landing pad, and the mod finds a planet with the surplus, picks the ship that arrives soonest, and flies it over, then brings spare cargo back on the return trip.

It stays out of your way: no spawning, teleporting or hand-inserting anything, ever. It only sets a platform's schedule. Edit a ship's schedule yourself and the mod backs off and leaves it to you.

You get a fleet monitor showing which ships are working, idle or stuck, with live ETAs. Set a reserve so a planet keeps stock before it exports, raise an item's priority so it ships first, pin a preferred ship to a route, and if you run circuits, hold a ship at its hub until your own 'ready' signal says go.

Available in 15 languages.
